goal: Prevent transaction fee underestimation and stuck transactions when mempool data is sparse or unready
Provide reliable fee estimates by falling back to block history instead of failing or using the fee floor
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Support for falling back to block policy to resolve downstream failures (instagibbs, stickies-v, achow101)
Confirmed to fix the issue through testing (tankyleo, polespinasa)
Objection that starved mempools will overestimate fees was answered with no reply (davidgumberg)
Unaddressed suggestion to add test coverage for block policy fallback (l0rinc)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it prevents severe fee underestimation that risks stuck transactions after node restarts
Resolves total fee estimation failures reported by downstream services like LDK when mempools are not ready
